therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: adoptive T-cell cytotoxicity against myeloma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Relapsed and lenalidomide-refractory multiple myeloma patients

results.effect_size: Median PFS: Cilta-cel NR (lower bound 34.50 months) vs. PVd/DPd 11.79 months (95% CI: 9.66–14.00)
results.target_engagement_evidence: CAR-T cell expansion, persistence, and activation markers monitored as secondary endpoints
biomarker_changes: Change from baseline in systemic cytokine concentrations in Arm B
Change from baseline in CAR-T cell activation markers in Arm B
Change from baseline in JNJ-68284528 T cell expansion (proliferation) and persistence in Arm B
Anti-JNJ-68284528 antibody levels monitored in Arm B
safety_signals: Serious adverse events including febrile neutropenia, anaemia, and neutropenia observed in both arms
Cytopenia, immune thrombocytopenia, lymphocytosis, and thrombocytopenia observed in Arm B (cilta-cel)
Acute coronary syndrome observed in Arm B (cilta-cel)
Hyperviscosity syndrome and pancytopenia observed in Arm A (standard therapy)

dose_info.dose: 0.75 × 10^6 CAR-positive viable T cells/kg (cilta-cel); Pomalidomide 4 mg; Bortezomib 1.3 mg/m²; Dexamethasone 20 mg/day (PVd) or 40 mg weekly (DPd); Daratumumab 1800 mg SC
dose_info.schedule: Cilta-cel: single infusion; Pomalidomide: orally; Bortezomib: SC; Dexamethasone: on bortezomib treatment days and following days (PVd) or weekly (DPd); Daratumumab: SC
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dexamethasone 10 mg/day (PVd) or 20 mg weekly (DPd) for participants >75 years of age

context.comparator: Pomalidomide + Bortezomib + Dexamethasone (PVd) or Daratumumab + Pomalidomide + Dexamethasone (DPd)
context.duration: Up to 3.9 years (primary PFS analysis); up to 7 years (secondary endpoints)
